prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting structural defects in a bridge maintenance report

1. Start with the maintenance records.
2.
completion:
Use the records to determine which structures you will be documenting on the particular day/week/month.
3. Write down the timemark for the records if applicable.
4. When you visit a structure to document it, do not review the notes on the structure until you are thoroughly done documenting yourself. This allows you to build an unbiased opinion rather than getting swayed by prior notes.
5. Conversely, try not to make notes on the structural evaluation database tablets or devices. This prevents contamination of these records as well.
6. Make a photo log so you can track which photos you have taken.
7. Before you approach the structure, examine it from a distance to see if anything looks unusual about the structure.
8. Walk the structure completely (only in office personnel vehicles for safety) to get overall observation of the structure from the transitway.
9. Get under the structure and be able to complete inspections or measurements from anywhere
